decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records Heyzine, white-label branding, client account ownership, and client upload responsibility; no additional change is needed.
The PDF delivery handoff does not change whitespace-balancing rules, while the separate no-extra-text clause is already captured by a same-message MODIFY.
Sending the final PDF to the client for Heyzine upload does not alter the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The delivery handoff and Heyzine account arrangement do not change the selected article typeface or weight treatment.
The client-upload handoff does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
The source specifies who will upload the final PDF but does not revise the launch deadline or required launch state.
The PDF handoff and Heyzine upload responsibility do not modify the requirement to enhance low-quality image assets.
The source decision does not change author names, author photographs, their presentation, or their source.
White-label Heyzine hosting and client upload responsibility do not change the magazine layout's visual-style or color-use requirements.
